video.title: Mountain Weather Update 11/10, Meteorologist Chris Tomer

description:
Pattern shift for Intermountain West CA/UT/CO/WY is still on tap on/after 11/13-11/21 with a parade of storm systems.
For now, atmospheric river continues in the PNW/BC with heavy snow accumulation mid-mountain and higher.
